description: Removes a staff member's agency assignment to one client business, and removes the business membership if this assignment created it. Requires an agency owner or admin; only the owner can unassign an admin. It does not remove the person from the agency.

businessId.description: The client business to remove access from.

userId.description: The agency staff member to unassign.

name: agency_profile_unassign
title: Remove Staff Member from Client
